scoredJobs.title: Recruitment Partner (Inclusive Employment Australia)
mandatoryRequirements: Relevant qualifications in areas such as Employment Services, Community Services or other relevant areas is desirable

Previous experience in employment services including advanced barrier management, reverse marketing, placement of candidates into employment and provision of post-placement support will be highly regarded
Must hold a Driver's license as travel throughout the region will be required
preferredRequirements: Demonstrated experience in business development, account management or sales will be highly regarded
Strong networking and relationship building skills
Working knowledge of local employers and their recruitment demands
Performance focused mindset and proven experience achieving business targets and KPI's
responsibilities: Support employers in the Maroondah, Bayside and Monash regions in collaboration with local teams
Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the local labour market and emerging industries, with the goal of achieving ongoing employment opportunities
Proactively identify and develop new employer relationships, taking time to understand our employers' staffing needs and providing tailored recruitment solutions
Help employers adapt their process or roles to accommodate candidates with specific needs and maximising productivity and other benefits towards achieving their organisational goals
Engage job ready candidates and match with employers through referrals, job carving and reverse marketing to achieve sustainable outcomes
employerQuestions: Are you ready to join a respected, values driven not-for-profit organisation, thrive in a challenging yet rewarding role, and work closely alongside people with a disability to help them build their future career?
If your answer is YES! Apply now and complete the online application including a cover letter addressing the above requirements.
Your cover letter can be uploaded alongside your resume, or as one document.

If you are a person with a disability and require an adjustment, such as alternative application methods, or if you have a general enquiry about a role, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at employmentpluscareers@salvationarmy.org.au.
Please specify the job title and location in the subject line.
